title.zh: KuCoin与MEXC相继停止为俄罗斯和白俄罗斯用户提供服务
title.en: MEXC Announces Discontinuation of Services for Users in Russia and Belarus

current_state.zh: KuCoin以法律和监管合规为由，暂停向俄罗斯和白俄罗斯用户提供所有产品和服务，并将提供有序的资产提取退出流程。
current_state.en: KuCoin suspended all products and services for users in Russia and Belarus, citing legal and regulatory compliance, and will provide an orderly exit process for asset withdrawals.

updates.title_zh: MEXC 宣布停止为俄罗斯和白俄罗斯用户提供服务
updates.title_en: MEXC Announces Discontinuation of Services for Users in Russia and Belarus
updates.what_changed_zh: MEXC 宣布，作为全球合规工作的一部分，将停止为位于俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的用户提供服务，受影响账户将收到关于平仓和资产提取时间表的单独通知，资产仍然安全。
updates.what_changed_en: MEXC announced it will discontinue services for users located in Russia and Belarus as part of global compliance efforts, with affected accounts receiving individual notices on position-closing and asset-withdrawal timelines while assets remain safe.
updates.current_state_zh: MEXC 宣布，作为全球合规工作的一部分，将停止为位于俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的用户提供服务，受影响账户将收到关于平仓和资产提取时间表的单独通知，资产仍然安全。
updates.current_state_en: MEXC announced it will discontinue services for users located in Russia and Belarus as part of global compliance efforts, with affected accounts receiving individual notices on position-closing and asset-withdrawal timelines while assets remain safe.

updates.title_zh: MEXC停止为俄罗斯用户提供服务，平台币MX暴跌15%
updates.title_en: MEXC停止为俄罗斯用户提供服务，平台币MX暴跌15%
updates.what_changed_zh: 受MEXC宣布停止为俄罗斯和白俄罗斯用户提供服务影响，平台币MX暴跌15%，现报约1.695美元。
updates.what_changed_en: Following MEXC's announcement that it will stop serving Russian and Belarusian users, its platform token MX fell 15% to about $1.695.
updates.current_state_zh: MEXC已宣布将停止为俄罗斯和白俄罗斯用户提供服务，受影响账户将收到平仓和资产提取时间安排通知；公告后平台币MX下跌15%至约1.695美元。
updates.current_state_en: MEXC has announced it will discontinue services for users in Russia and Belarus, with affected accounts receiving notices on position-closing and asset-withdrawal timelines; after the announcement, its platform token MX fell 15% to about $1.695.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: MEXC announced it will stop serving Russian and Belarusian users as part of a global compliance push, sending its platform token MX down 15% to about $1.695.
updates.detailed_summary_en: MEXC announced it will stop serving Russian and Belarusian users as part of a global compliance push, sending its platform token MX down 15% to about $1.695.
